evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC error handling in src/httprpc.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes spec-incompliant HTTP 400 status codes for malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests and prevents an Assume assertion crash in debug builds. The crash requires RPC authentication and a debug build, while in release builds it corrects HTTP response handling for malformed payloads.
